run_notes: feature_head.py globs and processes every videos_rgb/*.jpg it finds with no subsampling of its own; each of these six sequences has ~2700-2940 frames (vs. seq131's original 28-frame staged sample), so each sequence was subsampled to 40 evenly-spaced frames that have both an RGB frame and a depth_npy match, via a symlink tree built by a scratch-only helper (not committed, not under raytun3r/ or autoresearch/experiments/) -- feature_head.py itself was not modified per the ticket's 'files I may touch: none'.

the six-sequence ADT-FOV tree on lambda_63 stores RGB frames as videos_rgb/*.png, not *.jpg as AriaLocalPairs (h1-rim-pose-value/code/adt_pose_value.py) globs for -- the subsample symlinks are named *.jpg regardless of source extension (PIL reads by content, not name), so this is purely a lambda_63 data-layout accommodation, not a behavior change.

the ticket's note to 'set H2_CACHE=/tmp/h2cache_<seq>' assumes feature_head.py reads that env var; the committed script does not (SCRATCH/PRED_CACHE/FEAT_CACHE are hardcoded module constants pointing at a CPU-Claude-machine-specific path). A small runner (not committed) imports the module and monkeypatches those three constants from $H2_CACHE before calling main(), achieving the ticket's intent without editing the script.
